en.headline: Construction worker jailed 22 years for raping daughter over decade
en.dek: A High Court judge described the 14 rapes and one anal offence as leaving the victim living in hell and said the defendant’s remorse appeared only superficial.
body: A 48-year-old construction worker was sentenced to 22 years in prison at the High Court on Tuesday after admitting 14 counts of rape and one count of non-consensual anal intercourse against his daughter over a ten-year period.

Deputy Judge Kwok Tung-ming said the offences began when the victim was 13 and continued until she was 23. The judge noted the defendant had used violence, ignored the girl’s illness or menstruation, and treated her as a sexual object. Psychological reports indicated the defendant posed a potential risk to society, and the judge had considered an indefinite sentence before settling on a determinate term.

The court heard the victim eventually collected audio evidence and reported the matter to police in 2024 after the final assault; forensic tests confirmed the defendant’s DNA. The judge told the defendant that 22 years could not erase the pain suffered and urged the victim to rebuild her life.

zh.headline: 地盤工強姦親女十年判囚22年 官指事主如活在地獄
zh.dek: 高等法院法官指14次強姦及一項肛交罪令女兒十年如活在地獄，被告悔意流於表面。
body: 48歲地盤工人承認在十年間14次強姦親生女兒及一項未經同意肛交罪，星期二在高等法院被判監禁22年。
暫委法官郭棟明指，罪行由事主13歲開始直至23歲。法官指被告使用暴力，即使女兒生病或經期亦不放過，視她為性玩具。心理報告顯示被告可能對社會構成危險，法官一度考慮無限期監禁，最終判處有期徒刑。
事主後來暗中錄音蒐證，於2024年最後一次被侵後報警，體內驗出被告DNA。法官指22年刑期無法抵消事主承受的痛楚，並寄語事主重新上路。
